text:
Julia K.: Hi team  I handed in my resignation today. Last day will be Fri Nov 30. I'm US-based but planning to move to the UK after my last day. Need coordination: COBRA timing, RSU exercise window + tax withholding if I exercise after leaving, final paycheck timing, pension/401k rollover guidance, laptop + phone return (Ill need an international label), keycard drop, and an exit interview. Also flagging two midloop candidates  who should pick those up?
People Ops: Thanks Julia  we'll run the offboard flow. Quick notes: benefits usually continue through month-end (coverage through 2024-11-30). COBRA packet emailed within ~14 days for US benefits; you then have 60 days to elect. We'll also send international shipping instructions for devices. Who should pick up the hiring loops?
Manager - Owen: I can take the two midloop candidates. Julia, please add quick notes in the hiring tracker and ping me on any scheduled debriefs.
Comp (Ravi): On RSUs: vesting and the post-termination exercise window depend on your grant and the plan. If your grant allows a 90-day exercise window, exercising while abroad can have tax implications. DM me and I'll pull your grant docs. Generally unvested shares don't vest on resignation.
Tax (Marta): If you exercise RSUs after leaving and relocate to the UK, you may face UK tax residency rules and double-tax considerations. We recommend a consult with the tax vendor; we'll include contacts. Also note US withholding rules can differ if you're not a US employee at exercise. We'll loop you in.
Payroll: Final salary, accrued PTO payout, and any prorated stipends will be processed on the next payroll run after termination. For US payroll that is Dec 15. Submit any outstanding expense reports by Nov 25 to be included. DM payroll for an estimate.
IT - Elena: We'll send an international prepaid label for laptop and phone. Please factory reset the phone and remove personal accounts. Ship keycard separately or drop at office; we'll include a small envelope. We'll wipe devices on receipt. Tentative deprovision schedule:
```
2024-11-30 09:00 PT - block new device enrollments
2024-11-30 13:00 PT - revoke elevated roles
2024-11-30 23:59 PT - full account disable
```
Security Bot: Reminder to transfer ownership of any service accounts or S3 buckets before offboard. We'll run an access audit 4 days before termination and rotate keys on disable. If you want any data removed from backups, flag it now.
Julia K.: Thanks  I'll add hiring notes and tag Owen. I have one small analytics bucket (julia-arch)  keep it until I hand it off. Also please DM tax/vendor contacts. Would like exit interview Tue Dec 4 AM if possible.
People Ops: Exit interview scheduled Tue Dec 4 09:30 PT. Action items: [Julia] add hiring notes + list of resources to exclude from auto-delete; [Elena] send return label + manage device wipe; [Ravi] confirm RSU docs and window; [Marta] send tax vendor contact and high-level guidance; [Payroll] calc final payout; [Security Bot] run access audit. We'll delay full account disable until handoff confirmed.
Comp (Ravi): I'll DM you the grant schedule and note any special clauses. If you plan to exercise, let's coordinate withholding and timing with Tax and Payroll.
IT - Elena: Label emailed (ticket IT-9988). Pickup scheduled Dec 2. Please confirm shipping address in DM.
Payroll: DM sent for payout estimate.
Julia K.: Confirmed address in DM. I'll post the handoff doc by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone :heart:
